relation_rules.primary: every shown supporting paper supports the relation (at most 2 papers shown per edge)
relation_rules.secondary: supported in at least half of the shown papers
relation_rules.strata: same_sentence (every shown paper has both endpoints in one sentence) and cross_sentence; up to 50 edges per stratum and predicate, all when fewer
relation_rules.overall: population-weighted across strata; per-stratum Wilson intervals are reported

unclear_verdicts: excluded from the primary figure; counted as incorrect in a sensitivity figure; the unclear count is reported on every row
overlap: 20% of items judged by both channels A and B; kappa on the raw A/B answers; every A/B disagreement is decided by a third fresh-context adjudicator C
isolation: channels A, B and C are fresh contexts that see only their packet and docs/final-exam/enrichment-labeling-guideline-v1.md; the session that built the pipeline does not judge
